en.hero_title: Writing C, tuning kernels, and shipping tools that live right on physical hardware.
en.hero_bio: I’m Wildhan (@noticesa), an independent software builder based in East Java. No cloud dependencies, no speculative abstractions. Most of my work runs locally on physical Android devices—building kernel modules, patching system daemons, and writing low-overhead tools that stay fast on constrained silicon.
en.notes_text: Prefer zero runtime bloat over convenience. If a utility can run reliably as a native single binary or lean script on local hardware without cloud servers, that's where it belongs.
en.cta_title: Have an idea or want to talk low-level systems?
en.cta_sub: I’m around on Telegram pretty much daily. Send a message if you want to discuss.
en.footer_tag: Self-hosted & served directly from an Android device.

id.hero_title: Nulis C, ngulik kernel, dan bangun tooling mandiri langsung di hardware fisik.
id.hero_bio: Gue Wildhan (@noticesa) dari Jawa Timur. Tanpa server cloud sewaan, tanpa abstraksi berlebihan. Sebagian besar hal yang gue bangun jalan langsung di perangkat fisik—ngoprek modul kernel, nge-patch daemon sistem Android, dan nulis tooling ringan yang tetap kencang di hardware terbatas.
id.notes_text: Prioritaskan performa murni daripada kenyamanan abstraction layer. Kalau sebuah tool bisa jalan stabil sebagai native binary atau skrip mandiri di hardware lokal tanpa server luar, di situlah tempatnya.
id.cta_title: Punya ide atau mau diskusi sistem tingkat rendah?
id.cta_sub: Gue aktif setiap hari di Telegram. Ping aja kalau ada yang menarik buat dibahas.
id.footer_tag: Self-hosted & di-host mandiri dari perangkat Android.
